music.creative_notes: A more rhythmic variation of the Day 12 ocean identity, retaining the three-note family while emphasizing foam, pullback, and repeatable wave cycles.
music.licensing_notes: Archive the Kie response and verify the account's current commercial-use terms before distribution.

brief.title: First Wave Pattern 01
brief.style: minimal rhythmic ocean study with a distinct original motif and tactile ASMR-like transients
brief.instrumentation: filtered wave noise, soft hand percussion, rounded sub pulse, glassy plucks, brushed texture
brief.structure: immediate tactile hook, repeating four-part wave cycle, mid-point pattern interrupt, soft loop return
brief.prompt: Create an original twenty-second instrumental built around the feeling of waves advancing and withdrawing. Open with a tactile transient and a short three-note motif, establish a restrained repeating pulse, create one subtle mid-point surprise, and finish on a breathable tail that loops naturally to the first sound.
brief.negative_instructions: vocals, spoken words, recognizable melodies, artist imitation, tropical cliches, ukulele, festival drop, harsh cymbals, aggressive bass, abrupt ending
